title: Misgendered immediately after gender-affirming surgery
summary: "I have repeatedly reported that I was misgendered immediately after gender-affirming surgery." The site owner asks what investigation, if any, Mount Sinai has conducted into this complaint.

title: Consented to "clitoral burial," not a "partial" or "incomplete" burial
summary: "I consented to a procedure described on my consent documentation as 'clitoral burial.' I did not understand myself to be consenting to what has subsequently been described as a 'partial' or 'incomplete' burial." The site owner disputes the surgeon's account of the preoperative discussion and asks for any literature, patient-education materials, diagrams, consent materials, or operative protocols showing otherwise.

title: Repeated, detailed complaints without a substantive response
summary: "Why have my repeated and detailed complaints not received a substantive response addressing the allegations I have raised?"

title: Complete records requested, due Monday, September 21
summary: "I want my records in full by Monday, September 21. If they have not been provided by the time the first version of the website launches, I will accurately document that they had not been provided as of that date."
